source.notes: Hand-copied from a user-saved local HTML copy in temp/ (wiki oldid 28032, edited 2026-08-19). The wiki says the logic output does not work unpowered, and indoors the station always shows no event.

parameters.name: Activate
parameters.description: 1 if device is activated (usually means running), otherwise 0

parameters.name: Lock
parameters.description: Disable manual operation of the Weather Station.

parameters.name: On
parameters.description: The current state of the Weather Station.

outputs.name: Power
outputs.description: Can be read to return if the Weather Station is correctly powered or not, set via the power system, return 1 if powered and 0 if not

outputs.name: Mode
outputs.description: The mode of the Weather Station: 0 NoStorm, 1 StormIncoming, 2 InStorm.

outputs.name: Error
outputs.description: 1 if device is in error state, otherwise 0

outputs.name: Activate
outputs.description: 1 if device is activated (usually means running), otherwise 0

outputs.name: Lock
outputs.description: Disable manual operation of the Weather Station.

outputs.name: On
outputs.description: The current state of the Weather Station.

outputs.name: RequiredPower
outputs.description: Idle operating power quantity, does not necessarily include extra demand power

outputs.name: NextWeatherEventTime
outputs.description: Returns seconds until the next scheduled weather event, or 0 if no weather event is scheduled.

outputs.name: ReferenceId
outputs.description: Unique Reference Identifier for this object

outputs.name: NameHash
outputs.description: Provides the hash value for the name of the object as a 32 bit integer.

outputs.name: NextWeatherHash
outputs.description: Provides the hash value for the name of the next weather event as a 32 bit integer.
